name: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition

categories.label: Points earned during play
categories.help: Everything already on your score track: tiles, completed regions, bonus tiles and goods sales.

categories.label: Unsold goods
categories.help: One point for each goods tile you did not sell.

categories.label: Silver coins
categories.help: One point for each silver coin you still hold.

categories.label: Pairs of workers
categories.help: One point for each full pair of worker tokens you still hold.

categories.label: Monastery end bonuses
categories.help: Points from your placed yellow monastery tiles that score at game end.

categories.label: Empty spaces
categories.help: Empty hex spaces in your duchy (key spaces excluded). Scores nothing; fewer wins a tie.

categories.label: Turn order place
categories.help: Your place on the turn order track, 1 for first. Scores nothing; the player furthest back wins a tie.

source.rulebook_title: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Hungarian edition)

notes: Special Edition rules (not the 2011 original, template 84876). Read in Hungarian from a distributor-hosted translation of the publisher rulebook; no English publisher PDF was reachable, so wording was checked against the Hungarian text. Solo (Chateauma), 2v2 team and cooperative variants excluded. Player count 2-4 for standard play comes from the rules text. Turn-order tie-break is read as the player last in turn order.
